descriptors.statement: Four living creatures, full of eyes in front and behind, are positioned around the throne on each side.
descriptors.symbolic_referent: Exalted angelic beings (cherubim-like) representing creation worshiping God

descriptors.statement: Four living creatures are present around the throne.
The four living creatures resemble respectively a lion, an ox, a man, and an eagle in flight.
descriptors.symbolic_referent: The fullness of God's created order represented before His throne

descriptors.statement: Each of the four living creatures has six wings and is covered with eyes all around and within.
descriptors.symbolic_referent: Angelic readiness, comprehensive vigilance, and perception in service to God

descriptors.statement: Four living creatures attend the divine throne, each having four faces (human, lion, ox, eagle) and four wings.
descriptors.symbolic_referent: Angelic beings (cherubim) who attend and bear the throne of God, representing the fullness of created life serving the Creator

descriptors.statement: The sound of the wings of the living creatures is like the sound of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army.
descriptors.symbolic_referent: The overwhelming majesty and power associated with the heavenly beings who attend God

descriptors.statement: Four living creatures are present in heaven before the throne of God.
descriptors.symbolic_referent: High-ranking angelic beings who attend God's throne and lead heavenly worship.
